name: v0.1.0 – Initial Release
body:
## hermes-sync v0.1.0

Unofficial companion CLI tool for syncing Hermes Agent ~/.hermes/ across devices via a private Git repository.

### What's in this release

- `hermes-sync init` — Initialize sync repo from ~/.hermes/
- `hermes-sync push` — Push config changes to Git remote
- `hermes-sync pull` — Pull and restore config on another device
- `hermes-sync status` — Show git status of sync repo
- Secrets encryption (.env, auth.json) via Fernet + PBKDF2 (passphrase-based)
- No external servers — your own Git remote only
- MIT License

### Not affiliated with Nous Research
This is a community-built tool, not endorsed by Nous Research.

### Links
- Repository: https://github.com/Black-Studio-ia/hermes-sync
